Subject: Proposed two-part enablement: evening office hours + weekday API deep-dive

Hi Alex / Aptitude onboarding team,

Thanks again for the momentum this week — excited to get your engineers into the sandbox and run a short console walkthrough followed by an API enablement deep-dive. To balance engineer availability across time zones, we recommend a two-part cadence:

1) Evening office hours (Q&A, quick console tour, live credential checks) — 60 minutes
2) Weekday API deep-dive (hands-on: auth, request patterns, batching, KV cache) — 90 minutes

Proposed slots (PST / EST / CET):
- Tue Jan 12, 2027 17:00 PST / 20:00 EST (office hours)
- Wed Jan 13, 2027 09:00 PST / 12:00 EST (deep-dive)

If those don't work, share preferred windows and I can consolidate. Attached: enablement_agenda_v1.pdf and a short preflight checklist we ask customers to confirm before the deep-dive.

Preflight asks (short):
- Sandbox credentials + IP allowlist (if applicable)
- A small prompt set/test prompt your team cares about for regression checks
- One engineer with API key & ability to run curl/python during the session

Ben and Soojin will run the sessions — looping them in for logistics.

Looking forward,
Naomi

--

- For the deep-dive we need a sandbox API key with at least token-generation rights; please provide either a time-limited key or a service account we can use.
- If Aptitude runs through a proxy or NAT gateway, ask your infra team to allow outbound to api.redwood.com (ports 443) and to whitelist the session IPs in the checklist.
- We'll host the office hours in a single Zoom meeting and then fork breakout rooms for the deep-dive lab.

Attached: preflight-checklist.txt (includes steps for SSO, token exchange, and example curl commands).

One more ask: if you have a short internal prompt set (3–5 examples), drop it in the thread so we can tailor the deep-dive to your use cases.
